purpose: Pupil-data-free traceability from the V1.8 objective to implementation and automated evidence. This record does not approve promotion or any external gate.

requirements.summary: The reviewed V1.7.0 release remains the byte-identical public entry while V1.8 stays isolated.

implementation_evidence.contains: protected V1.7 live entry is byte-identical

automated_evidence.contains: V1.7.0 stable loads its product shell without browser errors
V1.8 alpha is versioned without changing the stable entry point

limitations: V1.8 is not the published GitHub Pages entry and cannot replace V1.7 without explicit approval.

requirements.summary: Versioned skill, trial, Research-summary, recording-completeness, and model-dataset contracts are machine readable and drift checked.

automated_evidence.contains: trial schema versions and enums match the V1.8 runtime
Research visualises versioned trial recording completeness without treating repeats as errors

limitations: Schema completeness records field presence and structure, not correctness, validity, consent, representativeness, or research suitability.

requirements.summary: Constraint-first seeded lessons cover built-in and teacher-created categories with stored generator provenance and one-answer safeguards.

automated_evidence.contains: a fixed lesson seed reproduces target, options, and prompt wording
teacher-created categories generate reproducible personalised lessons and Research coverage

limitations: Generator integrity does not establish that practitioner-created categories are equivalent, pedagogically optimal, or effective.

requirements.summary: Per-skill and category-by-skill states, spacing, retention observations, support fading, dosage, teacher ratings, and transfer context remain descriptive and scope aware.

implementation_evidence.contains: Practice status and spaced retention observations

automated_evidence.contains: Research labels a spaced follow-up as an observed retention comparison
Research visualises support fading, dosage, and teacher-rated transfer observations
Research visualises versioned category-by-skill learner state without pooling trajectories

limitations: Statuses and trends are transparent planning aids, not mastery, causal, diagnostic, generalisation, or neural-plasticity measures.

requirements.summary: Next-session proposals require explicit teacher approve, adjust, decline, or defer decisions and retain review-to-session provenance.

automated_evidence.contains: teacher-reviewed recommendations persist locally and export an audit record
an approved recommendation is explicitly staged, linked to one session, and visualised

limitations: No proposal may automatically change a pupil level, support, category focus, research condition, or session.

requirements.summary: Browser event markers, protocol fields, timing diagnostics, artifacts, active-control tasks, and fixed-condition drift controls prepare later EEG study integration.

implementation_evidence.contains: ChoiceTrain pupil-free EEG marker conformance fixture 1.0.0

automated_evidence.contains: EEG conformance schema matches every runtime marker and locks the pupil-free parser boundary
EEG conformance fixture is deterministic, pupil-free, and covers every marker code
EEG protocol metadata and browser timing diagnostics are exported and visualised
fixed research conditions persist, block drift, reapply, export, and visualise adherence

limitations: Browser timestamps are not LSL or hardware triggers and do not validate acquisition latency, clock alignment, artifacts, or EEG signal quality.

requirements.summary: A deny-by-default, purpose-gated, pseudonymised model-development export uses an allowlist and excludes direct identifiers, free text, images, exact dates, and raw coordinates.

implementation_evidence.contains: ChoiceTrain privacy-minimised model-development dataset core contract v1

automated_evidence.contains: model-development export is denied by default without a recorded authority declaration
pseudonymised AI research export excludes direct identifiers and free text

limitations: Pseudonymised data remains personal data and still requires an approved purpose, authority, secure transfer, retention, bias review, and human oversight.

requirements.summary: Research separates attention families and visualises accuracy, response speed, omissions, commissions, variability, and observed learning slopes with readable alternatives.

implementation_evidence.contains: Attention Training family profile and observed change

automated_evidence.contains: Research separates Attention Training families and avoids unsupported slope claims
Research visualises error, timing-consistency, and touch trends with observed-value counts

limitations: All attention and performance outputs are descriptive in-app observations and must not be presented as diagnosis or proof of neural change.

requirements.summary: Research visualises normalised touch behaviour, support and independence, dosage, spacing, maintenance, generalisation, and transfer observations.

implementation_evidence.contains: Maintenance, generalisation, and classroom transfer observations

automated_evidence.contains: Research visualises error, timing-consistency, and touch trends with observed-value counts
Research visualises support fading, dosage, and teacher-rated transfer observations

limitations: Touch geometry varies with device, layout, target size, scaling, and access method and is not a standalone motor or visual-field measure.

requirements.summary: Research covers content/category exposure, preferences, fidelity, practitioner-logged artifacts, EEG marker quality, and recommendation decision/use history.

implementation_evidence.contains: Fidelity, artifacts, and EEG marker readiness

automated_evidence.contains: teacher-created categories generate reproducible personalised lessons and Research coverage
an approved recommendation is explicitly staged, linked to one session, and visualised
EEG protocol metadata and browser timing diagnostics are exported and visualised

limitations: Fidelity, artifact, preference, and marker-quality views describe recorded implementation context and do not establish signal quality, stable preference, or causal effectiveness.

requirements.summary: The static candidate keeps data in the browser, contains no cloud LLM call, and rejects browser network transport primitives and runtime external requests.

implementation_evidence.contains: Local-only structured summary reserved for future LLM-assisted recommendations.
candidate runtime contains no external transport implementation

automated_evidence.contains: V1.8 alpha loads without making external runtime requests

limitations: Any future external model or cloud integration requires a new consent or authority, safeguarding, governance, security, and bias-review process.

requirements.summary: Learner mode, Teacher/Admin workspaces, profiles, speech, photos, themes, touch tracking, heatmaps, history, exports, EEG markers, and local persistence remain covered by the stable and candidate suites.

automated_evidence.contains: learner view hides configuration and provides a deliberate teacher return
admin navigation opens the correct research and system destinations
photo upload adds a labelled personalised photo and records its metadata in exports

limitations: Automated regression evidence does not replace representative staff and learner review on managed school devices.

requirements.summary: Release, promotion, schema, candidate, browser, compatibility, migration, export, and Research accessibility checks run in branch and Pages CI.

implementation_evidence.contains: Run mobile and WebKit compatibility smoke tests

automated_evidence.contains: Research is a separate admin destination with accessible visual equivalents
V1.8 teacher and admin navigation remain reachable in the compatibility profile

limitations: Emulated Chromium and WebKit profiles do not prove physical-device, browser, assistive-technology, speech, touch, or classroom suitability.

requirements.summary: Product, user, architecture, privacy, data, research-evidence, release, and validation documents state non-diagnostic and non-neural-claim boundaries.

implementation_evidence.contains: do not make the current app a diagnostic, therapeutic, or medically validated intervention
It does not connect to EEG hardware or provide clinical interpretation.
does not establish educational efficacy, clinical validity, legal authority, safeguarding approval, or hardware-synchronised EEG timing

automated_evidence.contains: promotion and external validation boundaries remain documented

limitations: Documentation records design rationale and boundaries; it is not ethics approval, legal advice, clinical validation, or evidence of effectiveness.

requirements.summary: Promotion requires a frozen exact commit, complete external evidence, accepted limitations, a passing guard, and explicit product-owner authorisation.

implementation_evidence.contains: Pupil-data-free engineering hand-off for external V1.8 review

automated_evidence.contains: a pending record cannot authorise release
complete evidence for the exact frozen commit passes the manual guard
review pack is pupil-data-free and excludes protected evidence fields

limitations: Automation can reject incomplete evidence but cannot perform or approve product-owner, school, safeguarding, governance, ethics, device, access, or EEG reviews.

narrow teacher workspace keeps the learner canvas out of the setup flow until preview

Research cards and wide tables remain contained on a small phone
mobile photo editor stays inside the usable viewport
sessionPayload.delivery_context
